title: Field Forms — Pack 4
notes: Replace the operator Safety landing page with a field-first forms hub for Pre-trip, FLHA, Incident, Near Miss and Equipment Inspection workflows.
Carry the active assigned job from Today into Safety, Field Ticket and Timesheet workflows instead of asking the operator to select the same job again.
Prefill field context Northborn already knows, including operator, job, customer, site, assigned unit and schedule where available.
Use one-tap Pass, Defect and N/A inspection controls sized for field use.
Expand defect details only when Defect is selected, including description, severity, remove-from-service and optional defect photo.
Store inspection detail inside the existing safety submission record and upload defect photos through the existing safety attachment system.
Prefill FLHAs from the job passed from Today.
Restrict operator field-ticket job choices to assigned work and prefill the assigned unit when possible.
Open timesheets from Today with the assigned job already selected.
Remove the duplicate legacy operator mobile navigation from Safety so Pack 2's global role-aware navigation remains the single phone navigation system.
